tasks.label: Check stable framework versions
tasks.command: npm view next version; npm view postcss version; npm view @supabase/ssr version

tasks.label: Check auth callback route
tasks.command: try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:3000/auth/callback' -UseBasicParsing -MaximumRedirection 0 -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response) { Write-Output ('HTTP ' + [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode); Write-Output ('Location ' + $_.Exception.Response.Headers['Location']) } else { throw } }

tasks.label: Configure Vercel environment
tasks.command: 'https://weaueiulvzzcjvdnoglj.supabase.co' | npx --yes vercel env add NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL production; 'sb_publishable_8RohPCwQv01_oE5-jYsbeA_wwWYWroD' | npx --yes vercel env add NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY production; 'https://sitefotosportifolio.vercel.app' | npx --yes vercel env add NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL production

tasks.label: Verify public deployment
tasks.command: $home = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://sitefotosportifolio.vercel.app' -UseBasicParsing; $login = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://sitefotosportifolio.vercel.app/admin/login' -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output ('Home HTTP ' + [int]$home.StatusCode); Write-Output ('Login HTTP ' + [int]$login.StatusCode); Write-Output ('Home bytes ' + $home.Content.Length)

tasks.label: Verify production routes
tasks.command: try { $publicResponse = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://sitefotosportifolio.vercel.app' -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('Home HTTP ' + [int]$publicResponse.StatusCode) } catch { Write-Output ('Home error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; try { $loginResponse = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://sitefotosportifolio.vercel.app/admin/login' -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('Login HTTP ' + [int]$loginResponse.StatusCode) } catch { Write-Output ('Login error: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }

tasks.label: Verify callback production route
tasks.command: try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://sitefotosportifolio.vercel.app/auth/callback' -UseBasicParsing -MaximumRedirection 0 -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; Write-Output 'Unexpected success' } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response) { Write-Output ('Callback HTTP ' + [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__); Write-Output ('Callback location ' + $_.Exception.Response.Headers['Location']) } else { Write-Output $_.Exception.Message } }

tasks.label: Verify redesigned website
tasks.command: $publicResponse = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://sitefotosportifolio.vercel.app' -UseBasicParsing; $loginResponse = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://sitefotosportifolio.vercel.app/admin/login' -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output ('Home HTTP ' + [int]$publicResponse.StatusCode); Write-Output ('Login HTTP ' + [int]$loginResponse.StatusCode); Write-Output ('Contains Projetos em Destaque: ' + $publicResponse.Content.Contains('Projetos em Destaque')); Write-Output ('Contains Bem-vindo: ' + $loginResponse.Content.Contains('Bem-vindo de volta.'))

tasks.label: Check GitHub repository setup
tasks.command: Write-Output ('Git: ' + (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source); Write-Output ('GitHub CLI: ' + (Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source); if (Test-Path .git) { git status --short; git remote -v; git branch --show-current } else { Write-Output 'No .git directory' }; Write-Output ('env.local exists: ' + (Test-Path .env.local)); Write-Output ('env.local ignored rule: ' + ((Get-Content .gitignore) -contains '.env.local'))

tasks.label: Initialize local Git repository
tasks.command: $git = 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe'; & $git init; & $git config user.name; & $git config user.email; & $git status --short; Write-Output ('env.local ignored: ' + ((& $git check-ignore .env.local) -eq '.env.local'))

tasks.label: Commit and push portfolio
tasks.command: $git = 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe'; & $git config user.name 'ihearvoicesalltime'; & $git config user.email 'ihearvoicesalltime@users.noreply.github.com'; & $git add .; & $git status --short; & $git commit -m "Initial photography portfolio"; & $git branch -M main; & $git remote add origin 'https://github.com/ihearvoicesalltime/sitefotosportifolio.git'; & $git push -u origin main

tasks.label: Finish GitHub push
tasks.command: $git = 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe'; & $git commit -m 'Initial-portfolio'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $git branch -M main; & $git push -u origin main

tasks.label: Push project to GitHub
tasks.command: $git = 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe'; & $git remote -v; & $git status --short; & $git push -u origin main
